Solar–Omnia long-stop date (close guided early to mid 2027)

offer_spreads.note: All-cash $14.00. Shareholders approved 23-Jul-26; antitrust pending; close guided Jan–Apr 2027.
Raised offer of EUR 14.40; ~35.0% tendered by 22-Oct vs 80% minimum; acceptances close 26-Oct, settlement 30-Oct. Price: Borsa Italiana close 23-Oct (Money.it).
Tendering 12–26 Oct-26 for 26% only (pro-rata risk). Rs 698 plus Rs 7.65 interest = Rs 705.65 per IDC.
All-cash ZAR 134.50 scheme; vote 5-Nov-26; competition approvals pending; close guided early to mid 2027 (long-stop 31-Jul-27). Price: Sharenet last trade 23-Oct-26.
